name: PixWorld
description: A 3D scene generator that reconstructs fully consistent 3D environments directly in pixel space from one or multiple reference images, avoiding the visual artifacts often caused by latent-space generation.
keyFeatures: Generates 3D scenes in pixel space rather than latent space
Four-step version generates scenes in ~6 seconds at 480p resolution
Fully open-source roadmap including data sets and inference code
curatorNotes: Partially enriched via migration on 2026-07-25. Manual review recommended.
